description: This Java class defines constants and utility methods used throughout the Hono project, including AMQP protocol details, security principals, connection management, and configuration parameters.

classes.name: Constants
classes.description: A utility class providing constants and static methods for managing AMQP connections, principals, and configuration within the Hono project.

methods.name: getClientPrincipal
methods.description: Retrieves the HonoUser principal from a Record or ProtonConnection, returning an anonymous principal if not set.

methods.name: setClientPrincipal
methods.description: Associates a HonoUser principal with a ProtonConnection.

methods.name: copyProperties
methods.description: Copies connection-related properties from a ProtonConnection to a ProtonLink.

methods.name: getConnectionId
methods.description: Retrieves the surrogate connection ID from a ProtonLink or ProtonConnection.

methods.name: setConnectionId
methods.description: Sets the surrogate connection ID on a ProtonConnection.

methods.name: isDefaultTenant
methods.description: Checks if a tenant ID is the default tenant.
